attributes.name: ypy-layer
attributes.description: Opens the response of this link, form or `ypy-get`-style element in a layer built on a native `<dialog>`, instead of swapping it into the page. The value is the kind of layer.

values.name: drawer
values.description: A modal panel at the edge of the screen.

values.name: popup
values.description: A non-modal dialog, anchored below its opener.

attributes.name: ypy-layer-close-on
attributes.description: Event names that accept the layer. The first event of one of these names, fired inside the layer (or on the page, for the top layer), closes it and its `detail` becomes the result value.

attributes.name: ypy-layer-close-on-url
attributes.description: URL patterns that accept the layer. When the layer navigates to a matching path and query (`*` matches any text) the page is not swapped in: the layer closes with the URL as its value.

attributes.name: ypy-layer-close-on-fragment
attributes.description: Selector that accepts the layer. When a response holds a matching element the response is not swapped in: the layer closes with the `ypy-layer-value` of that element as its value.

attributes.name: ypy-layer-outside
attributes.description: `false` keeps the layer open when the user clicks outside it. Default `true`.

attributes.name: ypy-layer-escape
attributes.description: `false` keeps the layer open on Esc. Default `true`.

attributes.name: ypy-layer-history
attributes.description: Shows the URL of the layer in the address bar while it is open; Back closes the layer.

attributes.name: ypy-layer-side
attributes.description: The side a drawer comes from, written as `data-ypy-layer-side` on the dialog for the style.

attributes.name: ypy-layer-label
attributes.description: The accessible name of the layer (`aria-label`). Without it the first heading of the content names the layer.

attributes.name: ypy-layer-class
attributes.description: Classes added to the dialog of this layer, after those of `config.layers.classes`.

attributes.name: ypy-layer-accept
attributes.description: Inside a layer: a click on this element accepts the layer. The value, parsed as JSON when it is valid and kept as text otherwise, is the result value.

attributes.name: ypy-layer-dismiss
attributes.description: Inside a layer: a click on this element dismisses the layer. The value is the reason (default `dismissed`).

attributes.name: ypy-layer-value
attributes.description: On an element of a response matched by `ypy-layer-close-on-fragment`: the value the layer is accepted with, as JSON or text.

events.name: ypy:layer:before:open
events.description: Fires on the opener (or on the document for a call of `ypy.layers.open()`) before a layer is built. Cancel it to open nothing.

events.name: ypy:layer:opened
events.description: Fires on the dialog once its content is in and it is shown, with the focus inside.

events.name: ypy:layer:before:close
events.description: Fires on the dialog before it closes, by accept or dismiss. Cancel it to keep the layer open (for example, unsaved changes).

events.name: ypy:layer:accepted
events.description: Fires on the dialog, still in the page, when the layer is accepted. `detail.value` is the result value.

events.name: ypy:layer:dismissed
events.description: Fires on the dialog, still in the page, when the layer is dismissed. `detail.reason` says why: `escape`, `outside`, `parent`, `history`, `toggle`, `navigate`, `error`, `dropped`, `replaced` or the text given to `dismiss()`.

config.name: layers.style
config.description: `false` does not add the optional default stylesheet (zero specificity, `--ypy-layer-*` variables).

config.name: layers.scrollLock
config.description: `false` leaves the page scrolling behind a modal or a drawer. The lock is the attribute `data-ypy-layer-lock` on `<html>`.

config.name: layers.outside
config.description: Whether a click outside a layer dismisses it.

config.name: layers.history
config.description: Whether layers show their URL in the address bar by default.

config.name: layers.classes
config.description: Classes added to the dialog of each kind (`modal`, `drawer`, `popup`), for example Tailwind utilities, and `opener`, the class a popup puts on its opener for anchoring.

classes.name: ypy-layer-opener
classes.description: Put on the element that opened a popup while the popup is open, so the default style can anchor the popup below it.

headers.name: YPY-Layer
headers.description: Sent with every request that fills a layer or starts inside one: the kind of layer (`modal`, `drawer` or `popup`), so the server can answer a fragment without the page chrome. Send `Vary: YPY-Layer` when the answer is cacheable.

headers.name: YPY-Open-Layer
headers.description: Opens a layer instead of swapping the response. A JSON object with `url` or `html` and the options `mode`, `closeOn`, `closeOnUrl`, `closeOnFragment`, `history`, `side`, `label`, `outside`, `escape` and `class`; any other value is the URL of the layer. Write non-ASCII characters as \u escapes.
